# attributed language

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attributedLanguage`](gmeow-attributedLanguage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attributedLanguage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The language assigned to an inscription by a script/language attribution. Non-functional: competing language assignments from different standpoints coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), and an attribution may assign multiple languages (bilingual inscription).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ScriptLanguageAttribution`](../classes/gmeow-ScriptLanguageAttribution.md) -> [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:attributedLanguage`](gmeow-attributedLanguage.md) from [`gmeow:ScriptLanguageAttribution`](../classes/gmeow-ScriptLanguageAttribution.md) to [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
